title: Higher-Order Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Dynamics
summary: The ability to derive the governing equations of a dynamical system from data is essential for prediction and control across many scientific fields. Two challenges, however, are the expansion of candidate terms when reducing higher-order equations to first-order form and noise from estimating derivatives. We propose Higher-Order-KANDy, which addresses both problems by using delay and derivative ("jet") embeddings of the original data with derivative-ordered Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Dynamics (KANDy) layers stacked into a machine learning architecture.
